guide.description: A visual guide and proportional standard for writing Baybayin characters.

constraints.rule: Place each character inside the grid; the central vertical and horizontal lines may be used as axes.
For a character with a descending flow, begin at Grid 1.
For a circular character, begin at central Grid 10.
For an open curve, follow a rightward and downward flow.
For a closed or spiral form, follow an upward or circular flow.
Place a kudlit above or below the base character according to the sound changed; it remains outside the base grid and at a standard size.
Keep each character’s width and height equivalent to the overall grid size.

requiredReferenceTemplate.approvalRequirement: A Baybayin writing expert must approve every template before it is used to pass or fail a learner.
requiredReferenceTemplate.reason: The source supplies system-level guidance and visual examples, but a handwriting validator needs explicit, normalized stroke paths and tolerances.

sourceVisualIndex.targetGroup: base characters and their key strokes
